summary.text: Anthony Moore has represented Oklahoma House District 57, which includes Custer, Roger Mills, and Beckham counties, since his election in 2020. In 2024, he was elected Speaker Pro Tempore by his House colleagues.

paragraphs.text: A fifth-generation native of Custer County, Moore graduated from Clinton High School and Oklahoma Christian University, where he earned a degree in Governmental and Legal Studies, graduating summa cum laude.
He earned his Juris Doctor from Oklahoma City University School of Law in 2007.

Moore began his career as a landman in the oil and gas industry before serving as an Assistant District Attorney for Latimer, Washita, and Custer Counties, and he now practices civil law focused on oil and gas and property law.
He previously chaired the Clinton Chamber of Commerce Board of Directors and served as president of the Custer County Bar Association, and he serves as a deacon at the Clinton Church of Christ.
